device.description: A piece of equipment. The id is yours; the kind comes from the list.

device on one line.description: A device with a single port, on one line.

device with a range of ports.description: CH[1..16] expands to sixteen ports, drawn in the order written.

device from a model.description: One unit of equipment declared with `model`.

adapter.description: A passive part: a splitter, a Y-lead. Lands on the parts list, not the equipment list.

model.description: Equipment declared once and instantiated with `device … from`.

group.description: A frame drawn around a set of devices.

diagram.description: Document settings. A theme here wins over the one a caller supplies.

connection.description: A run from one port to another, with a length and a cable number.

connection over a carrier.description: What is riding, and what it is riding on. The carrier decides the physics.

wireless connection.description: A radio path: a channel rather than a length, and nothing to coil.

connection with an adapter.description: A cable with a small passive part on the end. Two objects, two rows.

parallel connection.description: Several runs at once, paired in the order written.

signal.description: A signal type of your own, layered over the builtins.

compat.description: Override how a pairing is judged. The reason is shown in the diagnostic.

use.description: Bring in model, signal and compat declarations from another file.

gap.description: Space above the next port block. Appearance only; the wiring is unchanged.

adapter with a socket on one side.description: A part with one end moulded on and one that needs a cable.

connection with an unmeasured length.description: A cable that exists and has not been measured yet.
